name: bigscreen-survey-root
description: Bigscreen Survey - Application de sondage VR (Vue 3 + Laravel + MySQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" "cd backend_laravel && php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8000" "cd frontend_vuejs && npm run dev"
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml down && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down
